def test_remove_only_batch_keeps_sequence(env):
    db, w = env
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    db.insert({'x': 2})
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1}]) == []
    # No reuse of the removed ID, no rewind
    assert db.insert({'x': 3}) == 3
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 4}}]) == [4]


def test_preview_and_apply_see_direct_inserts_between_calls(env):
    db, w = env
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}]) == [2]
    db.insert({'x': 3})
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 4}}]) == [3]
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 5}}]) == [3]
    assert [d['x'] for d in db.all()] == [1, 3, 5]


def test_preview_does_not_mutate_operation_documents(env):
    db, w = env
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    op = {'op': 'insert', 'document': {'nested': {'a': [1]}}}
    assert w.preview([op]) == [2]
    assert op['document'] == {'nested': {'a': [1]}}
    assert w.apply([op]) == [2]
    assert db.all()[1]['nested'] == {'a': [1]}
EOF
python -m pytest -o addopts= tests/test_journal.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
